about: Reference judgements of the body flags (ingest/final/<paper_id>/structure.json body_flags) of the 44 papers, every flag of the 2026-10-13 passes judged on its line crop. flag_key = paper_id|page|kind prefix|number token. Verdict real error (error_type, cause a layout / c recognition / d our post-processing; set 13 or 31 = the paper group) or not an error (measurement_cause, fixable yes/no/maybe at judgement time). Used to score the flag review step before it is used. Pass 2 (2026-10-13, glyph table extended): 27 new flags judged on their crops (9 real, 18 not errors; 4 of the not-errors vanished after a further glyph entry).
